description: Source code for the GPIO driver for the Infineon TLE9104 device in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, register access, GPIO configuration, and communication handling.

methods.name: tle9104_set_cfg_cwdtime
methods.description: Sets the CWD timeout value in the configuration register.

methods.name: tle9104_calculate_parity
methods.description: Calculates parity bit for a 16-bit frame.

methods.name: tle9104_apply_parity
methods.description: Applies parity bit to a 16-bit frame.

methods.name: tle9104_check_parity
methods.description: Checks the parity of a received frame.

methods.name: tle9104_transceive_frame
methods.description: Performs SPI transceive with frame construction and parsing.

methods.name: tle9104_write_register
methods.description: Writes a value to a specific register.

methods.name: tle9104_write_state
methods.description: Updates the output state of the device.

methods.name: tle9104_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin for the device.

methods.name: tle9104_port_get_raw
methods.description: Attempts to read input pins (not supported).

methods.name: tle9104_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple output pins based on mask and value.

methods.name: tle9104_init
methods.description: Initializes the TLE9104 device, sets up GPIOs, SPI, and verifies device identity.
